extracted.intended_audience: suppliers/bidders for U.S. Indian Service contracts; government procurement officers and contract reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Specification and award criteria for supplying foodstuffs, dry goods, clothing, transportation, and related items to the U.S. Indian Service (advertisement of May 10, 1880). Includes product quality, packaging, weights/measures, delivery points, routing/transport notes, and evaluation procedure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figures indicate awarded rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Note.—Figures in large type denote the rates at which contracts have been awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Large-type numeric entries on the schedule are the award rates (the winning prices) rather than merely bids or estimates; use these figures to identify awarded contracts and comparators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards based on comparison of samples
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards were made on comparison of samples with which each bid was accompanied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acceptance/evaluation criterion: each bid had to be accompanied by samples; contract awards were made by comparing those samples (quality of sample was decisive along with price). Repeated across classes (groceries, textiles, clothing, boots, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Corn quality and packing
rubrics_metrics.description: CORN. (Full whole grain, sound, sweet and clean, weighing not less than 56 pounds to the bushel; to be delivered in well-sewed gunnies.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specification requires whole, sound, sweet, clean corn; minimum weight per bushel (56 lb) and specified packing (well-sewed gunnies). Multiple deliveries permitted as indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flour stock and milling yield
rubrics_metrics.description: FLOUR. ("Straight, full stock" of good, sound wheat, 60 pounds of wheat to the bushel; to be ground down to 43 pounds of flour; delivered in 8-ounce "osnaburgs.")
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flour must be produced from straight full-stock good sound wheat; conversion/yield and packaging mandated (43 lb flour yield; delivered in specified 8-ounce osnaburg sacks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Wheat grade and bushel-weight
rubrics_metrics.description: WHEAT. (No. 1, spring or winter, sound, sweet, and clean, ... a 56 pounds per bushel. b 58 pounds per bushel, without sacks. ... weighing not less than 60 pounds to the bushel.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wheat must be No.1 spring or winter, sound/sweet/clean with explicitly-specified bushel weights (footnotes indicate variations such as 56, 58 or 60 lb per bushel depending on packing/condition). Follow footnote weights for particular deliveries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oats minimum weight
rubrics_metrics.description: OATS (Bright and clean, weighing not less than 32 pounds to the bushel.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Oats specification includes cleanliness/brightness and a minimum bushel weight (32 lb).

rubrics_metrics.name: Hominy packing and quality
rubrics_metrics.description: HOMINY ... sound, and sweet, in good barrels. (also: cans of 5 and 10 pounds each.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hominy must be sound and sweet; acceptable packings include good barrels or cans of 5 and 10 lb as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hard bread quality
rubrics_metrics.description: HARD BREAD. (Best quality used by Army.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hard bread must match the best quality in use by the Army; sample comparison will confirm quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pemmican packing
rubrics_metrics.description: PEMMICAN ... in good tight cases, well strapped.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pemmican must be packed in good, tight, well-strapped cases; packaging is mandatory for acceptance/shipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Salt packing
rubrics_metrics.description: SALT. (Good quality, packed ... in strong barrels.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Salt must be of good quality and packed in strong barrels (packaging quality required).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rice quality
rubrics_metrics.description: RICE. (Good quality, delivered ... )
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rice must be good quality; delivery locations and quantities specified in schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lard grade and packing
rubrics_metrics.description: LARD. ("Prime steam," in tin cans.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lard must be prime steam grade and packed in tin cans as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mess pork preservation
rubrics_metrics.description: MESS PORK. (Well preserved.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mess pork is required to be well preserved to pass sample/comparison inspection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coffee quality/classification
rubrics_metrics.description: COFFEE. (ground, of good sound grain.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coffee must be ground from good, sound beans; other schedule entries list weights/price per pound and points of delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tea classification
rubrics_metrics.description: TEA. (Oolong, superior to fine trade classification.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tea specification requires oolong superior to the fine trade classification; samples will be compared to this standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tobacco classification
rubrics_metrics.description: TOBACCO. (Navy plug, light color, uniform leaf, of growth of 1878.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tobacco must meet the navy-plug specification: light color, uniform leaf, specified vintage (growth of 1878) and will be sample-tested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Packaging and containment requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Packaging types specified throughout: well-sewed gunnies; 8-ounce osnaburgs; strong boxes ready for shipment; strong barrels; tin cans; barrels; bags; cases well strapped; per-barrel and per-case notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suppliers must pack items in the exact container types and weights specified for each commodity; nonconforming packaging risks rejection even if contents are acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delivery points and quantities
rubrics_metrics.description: Points of delivery listed for each item (agencies and cities) with specified quantities in pounds, barrels, bags, dozens, pairs, yards, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bids and deliveries must conform to the listed delivery points and quantities; schedule enumerates agencies/cities and amounts to be delivered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation routing and pricing footnotes
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing/footnotes: e.g., 'a All rail, via California.' 'c Rail to Sioux City.' 'Canal and lakes to Chicago, 28 cents less; rail and lakes, 15 cents less.' 'e Fully insured.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transportation contracts include explicit routing instructions and rate adjustments (discounts) for canal/lake routes; footnotes indicate applicability. Follow the specified routing and apply indicated rate deductions where applicable. Some routes require insurance (fully insured).

rubrics_metrics.name: Weights and measures explicitly required
rubrics_metrics.description: Numerous explicit unit weights and measures required: pounds per bushel for grains (56, 58, 60 lb footnotes), flour-ground yield (43 lb), per-barrel/ per-dozen/ per-yard quantities for other commodities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All bidders must observe the precise weights/measures stated for each commodity; acceptance and award rely on compliance with these numeric standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Textile/blanket specifications (points and weight)
rubrics_metrics.description: BLACKFACE BLANKETS: detailed listings such as '3½-point scarlet, 10 pounds; 3-point scarlet, 8 pounds; 2½-point scarlet, 6 pounds' etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Blankets and woolen goods are specified by 'point' (thickness/grade), color, and weight per piece; bids must match these classifications and include samples for comparison.

rubrics_metrics.name: Woolen goods and clothing samples/specs
rubrics_metrics.description: Woolen goods and clothing classes list cloth types, colors (blue, scarlet, gentian), yardages, flannels (red, blue), hose, plaids, cloth weights and other detailed textile specs; awards were made on comparison of samples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Textile and clothing bids must supply samples matching the listed fabric types, weights, patterns and yardages; acceptance depends on sample comparability and meeting listed specs (color, twill, yardage).

rubrics_metrics.name: Footwear and clothing item specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Classes list boots and shoes by category (boots men's, rubber boots, shoes men's/women's/children's), clothing by garment (overcoats, pants, shirts, blouses) with counts and price rates; samples accompanied bids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footwear and clothing must conform to the enumerated item types, sizes, materials, and construction standards as evidenced by submitted samples; pricing indicated in schedule reflects awarded rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notions and small goods specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Notions (buttons, needles, thread, pins, combs, tape-measures, thimbles, etc.) are listed with quantities and required pack types; prices and awarded rates shown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Small-wares must meet the specified material/type (e.g., agate buttons, brass pins, linen/ leather laces) and be delivered in the packaging/quantities listed; sample comparison applies where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Groceries and perishables standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Groceries class lists items such as apples (dried), allspice, baking powder, candles, com-starch, etc., with quantities and awarded rates; earlier product-quality language (good quality, sound, sweet, clean) applies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Groceries and perishables must meet the descriptive quality terms in the schedule (sound, sweet, clean, good quality) and be delivered in the specified pack counts/weights; sample or inspection likely required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-item footnotes and locality conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Many items include per-item or locality footnotes (e.g., 'a Per barrel', 'a At Baltimore', 'Canal and lakes to Chicago, 28 cents less', 'By lake', 'Freight for [agency] as far as [location] taken at same rate').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bidders and contracting officers must apply the per-item footnotes and locality-specific conditions when computing rates or arranging shipments; footnotes modify base rates, routing, or packing instructions.
